learning.explicit_task_end_rule: If first256 or wall deadline is the declared end, mark external truncation before inserting the real final transition into buffer/GAE/update. True physical terminal has priority. Use actual pre-reset observation and do not add a failure/timeout bonus or penalty.
learning.unfinished_buffer_rule: Save valid tail,optimizer,RNG,normalization and counts during ordinary shutdown. Continue in a later actual training window; do not require a separate recovery exercise.
learning.incomplete_environment_snapshot_rule: Start a new physical session if full environment state was not saved. Record real boundaries and do not claim uninterrupted physics or fabricate missing successors.
learning.evidence: Use normal update logs,real trajectories and saved checkpoint. Do not replace real learning by mock tests or inflate results into convergence/benefit claims.
learning.schedule: RAW then PANN, sequential independent subprocesses inside the same W123 window; do not reset deadline at phase changes.
entrypoint_adaptation: Use existing r21 engineering candidate and W1 local paths, not R11 frozen_controller index.
Reuse original PPO settings and explicitly map R12 learning fields to the existing joint_learning interface.
Use R12 outputs and the single current window deadline, nominal,60s sessions,curriculum off,5workers.
Remove six-stream waiting and update actual counts after optimization.
Mark sample-target/window truncation before buffer/GAE; physical terminal takes priority; do not count pending actions with no physical elapsed time.
learning.pann_runtime: Existing MaterialObserver uses JAX GPU/x64; W1 did not verify it or PPO dependencies. Resolve concrete dependency/weight issues in actual startup inside kaiwen-learn; no separate import/mock/recovery suite.
learning.recording: For this short W123 collect complete existing episode recording for all actual episodes, rather than full_recording only for the first. Preserve existing frequencies/schema, raw trajectories, actual arrays,transition/rollout/update data and normal checkpoints; no extra diagnostics fields.
